digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities and model configuration (Bedrock Claude cells)
propositions: native_structured_output is force-disabled for all Claude cells via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, but E1 measurements proved native structured output + thinking work on specific Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive, haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0)

native_output_with_thinking field is introduced but silently dropped at three ModelCapabilities construction sites (profile path, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), so override rows setting it to True do not reach the constructed record
The native_output_with_thinking field must be plumbed through all three construction paths and intersected conservatively in FallbackModel chains (all-true only when every candidate supports it)

Bedrock measured-cell rows must be scoped to exact model IDs and include account/region context and re-measure triggers; opus-4-7/4-8 are non-rows (server-side rejection under thinking) and stay fail-closed
Unit tests must verify native output is reached through both object and string-fallback paths, that plumbing mutations cause test RED, and that conservative chain intersection works correctly
